documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Project README for the Docker-Compose launcher of the YouTube Video to Structured Course Generator, covering quick start, usage, .env configuration, changes made vs. the upstream project, troubleshooting, and manual (non-Docker) development instructions.

documentation.name: README.md
documentation.summary: Default Create React App boilerplate README for the frontend, documenting the standard npm scripts (start, test, build, eject) and links to CRA/React learning resources.

documentation.name: robots.txt
documentation.summary: Search engine crawler policy allowing all user agents unrestricted access to the site (no paths disallowed).

documentation.name: requirements.txt
documentation.summary: Python dependency manifest for the backend service, pinning FastAPI/uvicorn, LangChain/LangGraph with Gemini and Groq integrations, video/audio processing libraries (yt-dlp, opencv, whisper, scenedetect, fiftyone), OpenTelemetry instrumentation, and PostgreSQL/S3 clients, with inline notes explaining resolved version conflicts.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Single-stage Docker build for the FastAPI + LangGraph backend, pinned to Python 3.10-slim for numpy/numba wheel compatibility, installing CPU-only PyTorch from a dedicated index before the rest of requirements.txt, then copying in the app and scripts directories and launching via scripts/start.sh on port 8000.

infrastructure.name: .dockerignore
infrastructure.summary: Excludes caches, virtualenvs, git metadata, and generated artifacts (frames/, transcripts/, logs) from the backend Docker build context to keep image builds small and deterministic.

infrastructure.name: .dockerignore
infrastructure.summary: Excludes node_modules, build output, .git, and log/OS artifacts from the Docker build context for the frontend image, keeping image builds fast and reproducible.

infrastructure.name: Dockerfile
infrastructure.summary: Multi-stage Docker build that compiles the CRA (react-scripts 5) frontend with node:20-alpine and serves the resulting static bundle from nginx:1.27-alpine on port 80.

infrastructure.name: build
infrastructure.summary: Build stage on node:20-alpine: installs dependencies with npm ci --legacy-peer-deps, copies public/src/tsconfig.json, bakes REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL, and runs npm run build to produce the static bundle.

infrastructure.name: nginx
infrastructure.summary: Runtime stage on nginx:1.27-alpine: installs a custom nginx.conf and copies the built static bundle from the build stage, exposing port 80 to serve the frontend.

infrastructure.name: docker-compose.yml
infrastructure.summary: Docker Compose stack definition that launches the full local application: Postgres for persistence, MinIO for S3-compatible frame storage plus a bucket-init job, Jaeger for tracing, the FastAPI/LangGraph backend with a DB-init job, and the nginx-served React frontend.

infrastructure.name: postgres
infrastructure.summary: Postgres 16 Alpine database service providing course/JSONB persistence, with a healthcheck gating dependent services.

infrastructure.name: minio
infrastructure.summary: MinIO service providing local S3-compatible object storage for extracted video frame images, exposing the S3 API and web console.

infrastructure.name: minio-init
infrastructure.summary: One-shot bootstrap job that waits for MinIO to be healthy, creates the storage bucket, and sets it to public-read for local image serving.

infrastructure.name: jaeger
infrastructure.summary: Jaeger all-in-one service acting as the OpenTelemetry/OTLP trace collector and UI for the stack.

infrastructure.name: backend
infrastructure.summary: FastAPI + LangGraph agent backend service, built from ./backend, wired to Postgres, MinIO/S3, and Jaeger via environment variables, exposed on port 8000.

infrastructure.name: backend-init
infrastructure.summary: One-shot database schema initialization job that runs scripts/init_db.py against the backend image to create the courses table once Postgres is healthy.

infrastructure.name: frontend
infrastructure.summary: React SPA built from ./frontend and served by nginx on port 3000, configured with the backend API base URL at build time.

config.name: .env.example
config.summary: Template environment file listing required and optional variables for the docker-compose stack: LLM API keys (Gemini, Groq), Postgres credentials, MinIO/S3 storage settings, and the frontend API base URL.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: Minimal root-level npm manifest declaring a single dependency, remark-breaks, likely used for markdown line-break rendering somewhere in the project's tooling or frontend.

config.name: package.json
config.summary: npm manifest for the React/TypeScript frontend, declaring dependencies (React 19, MUI, axios, react-router-dom, react-player, react-markdown, dompurify) and the CRA-based start/build/test/eject scripts.

config.name: tsconfig.json
config.summary: TypeScript compiler configuration for the frontend, enabling standard CRA-generated strict/JSX/module settings and scoping compilation to the src directory.

config.name: manifest.json
config.summary: Web app manifest declaring PWA metadata (app name, icons, theme/background colors, start URL) for when the frontend is installed on a mobile or desktop device.

config.name: project.yml
config.summary: Serena MCP project configuration defining language servers, workspace folders, ignored paths, tool exclusions, and default operating modes for the deep-harn repository.

list.name: Frontend UI
list.description: The React/TypeScript single-page application (CRA) — App and UploadPage components, the axios API client, global styles, and the static HTML shell that let a user submit a YouTube URL and view the generated course, quiz, and retention plan.

list.name: Backend API & Orchestration
list.description: The FastAPI application and its request-handling logic — the app entry point, the course-generation router, the LangGraph agentic pipeline (Gemini/Groq calls), video frame extraction, S3 upload helpers, and the SSE progress broadcaster.

list.name: Data Layer
list.description: Persistence for generated courses — the SQLAlchemy async engine/session setup, the Course ORM model, the async CRUD functions, and the one-shot database schema initializer run at container startup.

list.name: Infrastructure & Deployment
list.description: Container and orchestration definitions for the whole stack — backend and frontend Dockerfiles, the docker-compose services (Postgres, MinIO, Jaeger, backend, frontend, and their init jobs), the nginx static-file config, and the backend container entrypoint script.

list.name: Configuration
list.description: Project and build configuration — the root and frontend npm manifests, the frontend TypeScript compiler config, the PWA manifest, the .env template for the compose stack, and tooling configs for Serena and Understand-Anything.

list.name: Documentation
list.description: Project-facing documentation and dependency manifests describing how to run the stack and what the backend depends on — the root and frontend READMEs, the crawler policy, and the annotated Python requirements file.

file:frontend/src/App.test.tsx.name: App.test.tsx
file:frontend/src/App.test.tsx.summary: Default Create React App smoke test that renders the App component and asserts a 'learn react' link is present; a leftover CRA template test not updated for this project's actual UI.

file:frontend/src/App.tsx.name: App.tsx
file:frontend/src/App.tsx.summary: Root application component that sets up React Router and routes the single '/' path to the UploadPage component.

file:frontend/src/index.tsx.name: index.tsx
file:frontend/src/index.tsx.summary: CRA bootstrap file that mounts the App component into the DOM root element inside React.StrictMode and kicks off web-vitals reporting.

file:frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx.name: UploadPage.tsx
file:frontend/src/pages/UploadPage.tsx.summary: Main and only application page: lets a user submit a YouTube URL, triggers course generation via the backend API, streams live progress over Server-Sent Events, and renders the resulting course content, quiz, and retention-plan tabs using Material UI.

file:frontend/src/reportWebVitals.ts.name: reportWebVitals.ts
file:frontend/src/reportWebVitals.ts.summary: CRA performance-measurement helper that lazily loads the web-vitals library and reports Core Web Vitals metrics (CLS, FID, FCP, LCP, TTFB) to a caller-supplied callback.

file:frontend/src/services/api.ts.name: api.ts
file:frontend/src/services/api.ts.summary: Thin Axios-based API client that kicks off course generation on the backend by POSTing a YouTube video URL to /api/generate-course, with the base URL configurable via REACT_APP_API_BASE_URL.

file:backend/app/api/__init__.py.name: __init__.py
file:backend/app/api/__init__.py.summary: Empty package marker that makes the api directory importable as the backend.app.api Python package.

file:backend/app/api/frame_extraction.py.name: frame_extraction.py
file:backend/app/api/frame_extraction.py.summary: Video processing pipeline that downloads a YouTube video via yt-dlp, detects scene boundaries, extracts and optimizes keyframes, loads them into a FiftyOne dataset to select visually unique frames, and aligns the selected frames to transcript timestamps.

file:backend/app/api/routes.py.name: routes.py
file:backend/app/api/routes.py.summary: Core FastAPI router for the course-generation feature: exposes endpoints to kick off course generation from a YouTube URL and to stream progress over SSE, orchestrating transcript fetching (with Whisper fallback), frame extraction, the LangGraph agent pipeline, S3 frame uploads, and course persistence.

file:backend/app/api/s3_utils.py.name: s3_utils.py
file:backend/app/api/s3_utils.py.summary: Initializes a boto3 S3 (or S3-compatible, e.g. MinIO) client from environment variables and provides a helper to upload a local keyframe file to the configured bucket, returning its public URL.

file:backend/app/main.py.name: main.py
file:backend/app/main.py.summary: FastAPI application entry point: creates the app, configures CORS, mounts the local frames directory as static files, and registers the API router under /api.

file:backend/app/db/crud.py.name: crud.py
file:backend/app/db/crud.py.summary: Async CRUD layer for the courses table: creates a new Course record (with IntegrityError handling for duplicate video IDs), updates a course's status, and fetches a course by YouTube video ID.

file:backend/app/db/database.py.name: database.py
file:backend/app/db/database.py.summary: Configures the SQLAlchemy async engine and session factory from the DATABASE_URL environment variable, and exposes a test_connection helper used to verify database connectivity at startup.

file:backend/app/db/models.py.name: models.py
file:backend/app/db/models.py.summary: Defines the SQLAlchemy declarative Base and the Course ORM model storing generated course data (transcript, structured content, course content with S3 frame URLs, quiz content, retention plan, and status).

file:backend/scripts/init_db.py.name: init_db.py
file:backend/scripts/init_db.py.summary: One-shot database initializer run by the backend-init compose service: polls the configured DATABASE_URL until Postgres accepts connections, then idempotently creates any missing tables via Base.metadata.create_all.
